name: How should I prepare my home before interior log sealing begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before interior log sealing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contractors arrive, clear furniture, wall decor, and window coverings away from all log walls, ensuring at least three to four feet of open perimeter space. If your project includes cathedral ceilings, loft spaces, or tricky transitions into adjacent rooms, make sure pathways are clear for ladders and staging equipment. You should also note specific rooms with noticeable drafts or past water intrusion so the crew can pay extra attention to those joints. Identifying whether previous finishes were oil-based or water-based helps ensure the team brings chemically compatible sealing products.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture away from exterior-facing interior walls, remove wall hangings, clear work pathways, and identify any specific drafty or problem areas for the crew.
